name: City of Seattle - Digital Accessibility Policy

laws.summary: Directs City departments to make information and design inclusive, and is folded into the citywide digital accessibility policy.

policy_docs.title: Tech Talk - Seattle's New Digital Accessibility Policy (July 7, 2026)

applies_to: All City departments, staff, vendors, contractors and partner agencies producing public-facing digital content: websites, apps, reports, maps, social posts, online forms.

deadlines.what: Citywide Digital Accessibility Policy rolled out.
WCAG 2.1 A/AA conformance (Title II date as extended).

requires: No new digital tool or public-facing content launches without meeting accessibility standards
Existing materials updated or given alternate access by April 26, 2027
Inventory of all digital assets with reporting on evaluation and remediation
mobile: explicit - policy covers websites and apps with a mobile-first design emphasis.
procurement: Procurement includes a digital accessibility evaluation of third-party vendors.
enforcement: Internal (Digital Engagement team, citywide workgroup); federal Title II.
notes: Executive Order PDF URL from search results, not opened.
